answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of 38 confirmed judged findings, 29 map to a seeded defect and 6 are real but not seeded, so precision = 35/38 = 0.92 (3 not a problem: F-0020, F-0054, F-0106). Strict precision = 29/38 = 0.76; recall by meaning across all findings is 13/14 (only D13, the slot length and end time shown only in a tooltip, is missed; D02 and D11 come only from tool findings, so judged-only recall is 11/14).

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply orders a numbered 'Fix first' list 1-9 that opens with the 4/4-severity double-tap cancel, then a 'Next tier, all smaller fixes' list. Its Caveats say 'Not tested with real residents or real screen readers. VoiceOver and TalkBack runs are still needed', and it leaves the change/cancel-online item to the user as 'Your decision'.

mapping.title: Current step shown only by bold, not exposed programmatically
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The same run's reply says the markup marks the current step with aria-current="step" and calls this a probable false alarm, so as stated the finding is wrong.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved above the Morning heading, out of their group
mapping.reason: The CSS order puts 'Few left' slots at the front, so the Morning and Afternoon headings no longer sit above their slots. That is D10.

mapping.title: Selected day button barely differs from unselected days
mapping.reason: A 1.16:1 tint and a 1 px border difference make it hard for a resident to see which day is chosen. On a phone that risks booking slots for the wrong day. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Cancelled booking page headed 'Booked' and says show at the gate
mapping.reason: D09 describes the cancelled booking's done page still titled 'Booked' and saying 'Show this at the gate'. Here that is the downstream harm of the double press.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns to Today, not the booked day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on Today. That is D12.

mapping.title: Expired-slot message gives no next step and blanks the slot
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, 'This slot is no longer available.' appears with no reason and the slot line becomes a dash. That is D08.

mapping.title: Slot buttons' focus outline removed with no replacement
mapping.reason: The injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' removes the focus ring on slot buttons. That is D05.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved ahead of time order; visual and focus order diverge
mapping.reason: order:-1 pulls few-left slots out of time order while Tab keeps DOM order. That is D10.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the content box at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: The script sizes the columns from innerWidth, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. That is D04.

mapping.title: Book this slot shows no visible change during its 1.5 s wait
mapping.reason: Book doing nothing visible while the booking is made is D09.

mapping.title: Second tap on Book while pending saves the booking as cancelled
mapping.reason: A second press cancelling the booking is D09.

mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' when status is cancelled
mapping.reason: This is the same done-page harm D09 describes ('titled Booked', 'Show this at the gate') for a booking cancelled by the double press.

mapping.title: Slot list empty with no loading indicator for 0.9 s after a day change
mapping.reason: Nothing says the slots are coming, and the grid and status line are empty during the wait. That is D01.

mapping.title: Next does nothing while slots are loading
mapping.reason: Next doing nothing during the slot load is explicitly part of D01.

mapping.title: Today's past slots offered as free, rejected only at booking
mapping.reason: Today's started slots are offered and then refused at the final step. That is D06.

mapping.title: Returning to the when step drops the saved day and slot
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' (and 'Back to the slots') forgetting the chosen day and slot is D12.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours below 4.5:1
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' tag text is about 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark. That is D03.

mapping.title: Permit not checked on vehicle step; error only after booking, no link
mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty permit and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. That is D07.

mapping.title: Vehicle-step error summary links don't move focus to a control
mapping.reason: A keyboard or switch user who follows the error link lands on a container and must hunt for the vehicle button or waste checkbox. That is a genuine recovery barrier, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Vehicle and waste errors not tied to their controls
mapping.reason: Speculative. It says the errors 'do not appear to be' exposed, that a screen reader 'may not' announce them, and that 'this needs an accessibility-tree check', so it gives no observed basis.

mapping.title: 5-minute slot hold never disclosed
mapping.reason: No page shows the five-minute hold or its end. That is D08.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error doesn't say the hold expired or link to another slot
mapping.reason: The slot is dropped with 'This slot is no longer available.' without saying the hold ran out. That is D08.

mapping.title: Slot area shows previous day's date over an empty list while loading
mapping.reason: During the wait the slot area is empty, with no loading text, so nothing says slots are coming. That is D01.

mapping.title: Slot hold and its time limit not stated after choosing a slot
mapping.reason: The hold and its limit are never shown, and the slot is cleared at the final step. That is D08.

mapping.title: Permit field stays shown, unmarked, after 'Car' is chosen; explanation behind 'i' icon
mapping.reason: The harm is that residents cannot tell who needs a permit, because the rule sits behind an icon-only 'i' button. That is D07's permit rule.

mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state
mapping.reason: Book showing no progress for 1.5 s is D09.

mapping.title: Confirmation omits day, arrival window and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle. That is D14.

mapping.title: Vehicle step doesn't show the chosen day and slot
mapping.reason: The slot was chosen one step earlier and is restated, with a Change link, on the check-and-book page. Leaving it off the intermediate step is a design choice with no harm shown.

mapping.title: Permit help says apply on the council site but gives no link
mapping.reason: Van and trailer users who need a permit are told to apply elsewhere but given no way to get there, so they must search the council site. That is a genuine dead end, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Two-working-day permit lead time revealed only after a slot is chosen
mapping.reason: The permit information sits only in the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel behind the info button, so van users learn the rule too late. That is D07's permit rule.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking with the reference
mapping.reason: Residents who book in the evening for weekends can change or cancel only by phoning on weekdays 09:00-17:00. That blocks a top task. D12 covers 'Change slot' inside the flow, not an existing booking, so this is not seeded.

mapping.title: Vans and trailers help is an unlabelled icon among vehicle buttons
mapping.reason: The permit rule is given only behind an icon-only info button. That is D07.

mapping.title: Past slots on Today offered as free and rejected at the final step
mapping.reason: Today's started slots are shown as free and refused after Book. That is D06.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' reopens on Today instead of the booked day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day, including after an expired hold. That is D12.

mapping.title: Invalid 'Another day' date leaves previous day's slots selectable
mapping.reason: After a bad date the resident sees the error but can still pick a slot under it and carry on booking a day they did not ask for. That is a genuine wrong-day risk, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Keyboard focus on slot buttons has no visible indicator
mapping.reason: The slot buttons show no visible focus. That is D05.

mapping.title: No indication of how long a chosen slot is held
mapping.reason: The hold and its length are never shown. That is D08.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
mapping.reason: Same problem as F-0058: change or cancel is by weekday phone only, while residents book in the evening for weekends. Genuine, and not seeded.

mapping.title: axe color-contrast 3.02:1 on 'Few left'
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' tag is #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 3.02:1. That is D03.

mapping.title: 'Few left' text contrast below 4.5:1
mapping.reason: 'Few left' at 3.02:1 is D03.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: The slot grid overflows the viewport at 320 px, so the page scrolls sideways. That is D04.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: This is the same slot-grid overflow at 320 px, D04.

mapping.title: Status '20 slots free' not announced
mapping.reason: The live region is inserted together with the slot count, so the count is never announced. That is D11.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on '08:00'
mapping.reason: A slot button shows no focus change. That is D05.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because 'Few left' slots were reordered visually. That is D10.

mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
mapping.reason: The 1.2 s operation after choosing a permit vehicle is D07's delayed permit field.

mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 budget on /
mapping.reason: CLS 0.169 moving #opening when the slots arrive is D02.
